    SELECT C.CUSTOMER_ID, C.FIRST_NAME, C.LAST_NAME, C.REGION_ID,
           SUM(OI.QUANTITY * OI.UNIT_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SPEND,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY C.REGION_ID ORDER BY SUM(OI.QUANTITY * OI.UNIT_PRICE) DESC) AS SPEND_RANK

)
